title: Product Capability Support Matrix
brief: Build one machine-readable support matrix mapping runtime capabilities to supported/partial/bridge_only/experimental/unsupported/planned. Populate for machines, controllers, CAM systems, exports, physics, quoting. Require all docs and claims to consume this matrix.

units.title: Populate for all engine families and product pillars
Define promotion/downgrade rules between support states

exit_conditions: No capability can be sold/documented/roadmap-marked outside the same support-truth matrix
